In 1761, the third Family Compact (Pacte de Famille) was made between King Charles III of Spain and King Louis XV of France [d1, d7]. This defensive alliance was signed on 15 August 1761 and brought Spain into the Seven Years' War on the French side [d1, d2, d4]. Separately, the Treaty of El Pardo was signed on 12 February 1761 between the Spanish and Portuguese empires [d3]. Additionally, 1760-1761 saw Peace and Friendship Treaties signed between the British government and Indigenous tribes in Nova Scotia [d9].
